policy.name: Telangana MSME Policy 2024 (Incentive Scheme) - Operational Guidelines for Implementation of MSME Policy (Incentive Scheme), 2024
policy.order_no: G.O.Ms.No.16, Industries & Commerce (FP & MSME) Department, dated 18-09-2024

zones.ELIGIBLE: Whole state outside GHMC (Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation) limits, plus existing/new Industrial Estates/Parks inside GHMC
zones.GHMC_EXCLUDED: Inside GHMC limits outside industrial estates/parks, and Sanathnagar, Azamabad, Chandulal Baradari and Kattedan Industrial Estates - no incentives (SC/ST/PwD may set up Annexure I(A) activities in GHMC)

zone_lookup: Guidelines para 1.2 'Area of Operation' (p.6); no district categorisation.

schemes.name: Investment Subsidy - Micro & Small, General category
schemes.notes: 25% of eligible Fixed Capital Investment (land, building, P&M; computed per para 5). New units and expansion/diversification (>=25% increase in FCI and in capacity/turnover, paras 1.4.11-1.4.12). Expansion cap Rs 30 lakh includes subsidy availed earlier. Apply within 6 months of commercial production on TG-iPASS. Medium enterprises get no investment subsidy. Units commencing between 18-09-2024 and issue of guidelines may choose T-IDEA instead.

schemes.name: Additional Investment Subsidy - Women-owned Micro & Small
schemes.notes: Additional to the 25%/Rs 30 lakh general subsidy; combined max Rs 50 lakh.

schemes.name: Investment Subsidy - SC/ST/PwD Micro & Small manufacturing
schemes.notes: In lieu of general rate. SC/ST/PwD women: additional 20% up to Rs 20 lakh, max Rs 120 lakh per unit. (Service enterprises: 35% up to Rs 75 lakh.)

schemes.name: Net SGST Reimbursement - Micro & Small
schemes.notes: 100% of net SGST paid, for 5 years from commercial production or until 100% of eligible FCI reimbursed, whichever earlier (rate_by_zone = ceiling as fraction of FCI). Expansion: only SGST on production above 3-yr average base. Half-yearly claims with GST dept certified Form-A. Same for SC/ST/PwD (3.1.7).

schemes.name: Net SGST Reimbursement - Medium
schemes.notes: 75% of net SGST paid, for 7 years or until 100% of eligible FCI reimbursed, whichever earlier (rate_by_zone = FCI ceiling).

schemes.name: Interest Subsidy (Pavala Vaddi) - new Micro & Small
schemes.notes: Reimburses term-loan interest IN EXCESS OF 3% p.a. (unit bears first 3%), max 9% p.a. reimbursed, 5 years from commercial production. Term loans on eligible FCI only, disbursed within 6 months of DCP; NEW units only (not expansion); account must be standard/regular. Medium enterprises not covered. Same for SC/ST/PwD (3.1.8).

schemes.name: Reimbursement of Fixed Power Consumption Charges
schemes.notes: Rs 1.00/unit (Rs 1.50/unit for SC/ST/PwD, 3.1.5/3.2.5/4.6.2) on energy (kVAh) charges only, 5 years from DCP. Power from DISCOMs/CESS Sircilla in unit's name. Expansion: only consumption above 3-yr average base.

schemes.name: Quality Certification / ZED Certification Subsidy
schemes.notes: 50% of expenses, max Rs 2 lakh per certificate (general). SC/ST/PwD: 100% up to Rs 3 lakh per certificate (3.1.10/4.8.2). Patent registration 100% up to Rs 2 lakh (general). Available to new and existing MSMEs (4.8.4).

schemes.name: Cleaner Production Subsidy
schemes.notes: 25% of cost of specific cleaner production measures, max Rs 5 lakh; TGPCB certificate needed.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & transfer duty: 100% reimbursement on land purchase, lease, mortgage/hypothecation (Guidelines 2.1.1-2.1.2, 4.1).
Land cost rebate: 25% up to Rs 10 lakh in TGIIC/approved parks (SC/ST/PwD 50% up to Rs 50 lakh) (2.1.3, 4.2).
Land conversion charges: 25% up to Rs 10 lakh (2.1.4, 4.3).
Skill upgradation: 50% of training cost of local manpower up to Rs 2,000 per person, one-time (2.1.9).
Industrial Infrastructure Development Fund: 50% of infra cost for standalone units >10 km from estates, max Rs 1 crore (2.2.10/3.1.12).
Electricity duty: none found in the scheme.
unverifiable: G.O.Ms.No.16 dt 18-09-2024 itself not downloaded (industries.telangana.gov.in unreachable); figures read from the official Operational Guidelines hosted on TG-iPASS (ipass.telangana.gov.in), cross-checked with the MSME Policy 2024 booklet (invest.telangana.gov.in) p.20 (25%/Rs 30 lakh; women +20%/Rs 20 lakh; SC/ST 50%/Rs 1 crore).
No electricity duty exemption in MSME Policy 2024.
